# FileLinesContentRequest

A file's content as lines of text.

**Kind:** an object, used in requests.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `content` | `string[]` | yes | The file's lines, up to 100,000. May be empty. Constraints: maxLength: 100000, required (empty or whitespace-only strings are rejected). |

## Example

```json
{
  "content": [
    "..."
  ]
}
```

## Where it's used

- [`vfs.open(name).appendLines`](../api/vfs.md) (`PUT /namespaces/{namespaceName}/vfs/by-name/{name}/files/append/lines`)
- [`vfs.open(name).writeLines`](../api/vfs.md) (`PUT /namespaces/{namespaceName}/vfs/by-name/{name}/files/write/lines`)
- [`vfs.openById(id).appendLines`](../api/vfs.md) (`PUT /vfs/by-id/{id}/files/append/lines`)
- [`vfs.openById(id).writeLines`](../api/vfs.md) (`PUT /vfs/by-id/{id}/files/write/lines`)
